type7_finite_sample_cubic_mean_bounds.formula_note: For any finite sample of size N >= 2 with Hyndman-Fan Type-7 linear interpolation constraints (1-f05)*x[i05] + f05*x[i05+1] = p05 and (1-f95)*x[i95] + f95*x[i95+1] = p95 over sorted d_min = x[0] <= ... <= x[N-1] = d_max, compute_type7_finite_sample_cubic_mean_bounds_iip0033 checks exact feasibility and computes the exact global min/max of ((1/N)*sum(x_k^3))^(1/3) (0-variable exact evaluation for N <= 20 and N == 1 mod 20; exact 2D separable strictly-convex polytope minimization and vertex maximization for N >= 22 with fractional indices; 1e-9 tolerance).

fixed_pitch_bilayer_and_holds.route1_fvm_model_scope_note: Route 1 3D FVM runs model chronic vascularized hydrogel perfusion (k_perf = 0.1358 s^-1, zero active CaO2 source) across both aligned and staggered 2-layer registries on all 3 meshes, and explicitly separate pure +10% OCR (15.0 um standoff) from coupled +10% OCR + 16.5 um standoff. On 8-site supercells, one-68 and one-70 tails carry cell maxima of 68.0/70.0 um and exact 8-site Type-7 p95 of 66.95/68.25 um (both serialized per run). Aggregate lot histogram tolerances (p05 >= 58, d_rms3 <= 65, p95 <= 68, d_max <= 70, <= 1,500 IEQ/cm^2) are necessary-not-sufficient: segregated 8-site placement (14.2990 vs computed redistributed control 15.7151 mmHg at nx=40, and 14.2694 vs 15.7178 mmHg staggered at nx=80, all at 15.0 um standoff and identical histogram) and coupled 32-site stress (14.6672 mmHg) robustly fail < 15.0 mmHg on Route 1 390 um (while the marginal 32-site pure +10% OCR case is axially mesh-sensitive: 14.9832 / 15.0384 / 15.1628 mmHg at nz = 78 / 117 / 156), mandating explicit worst-location stress pO2 >= 15.0 mmHg across BOTH Route 1 350 um and Route 1 390 um plus direct loaded-coupon verification.
fixed_pitch_bilayer_and_holds.day0_bed_40mmhg_policy_floor_note: 40.0 mmHg Day-0 avascular bed pO2 is a conservative Stage-0 policy floor rather than the physical minimum: at 40.0 mmHg bed pO2, paired (face, core) minima are 19.44 / 18.25 mmHg at 1.00x OCR and 17.50 / 16.19 mmHg at 1.097x OCR; at 1.097x demand, 38.0 mmHg bed pO2 passes at 15.5545 mmHg face / 14.2564 mmHg core, whereas 30.0 mmHg fails at 9.81 / 8.65 mmHg.

spatial_counterexamples_necessary_not_su.axial_refinement_note: For 32-site Route 1 390 um pure +10% OCR at nx = 80, axial refinement nz = 78 -> 117 -> 156 shifts worst face from 14.9832 mmHg (below 15.0) to 15.0384 and 15.1628 mmHg (above 15.0). That single marginal case is mesh-sensitive; the segregated 8-site placement counterexample (14.2990 vs computed redistributed control 15.7151 mmHg at nx = 40, 15.0 um standoff) and coupled +10% OCR + 16.5 um standoff stress (14.6672 mmHg) carry the robust failure signal.
